def tokenize_function and all training code (tokenized_dataset = ..., TrainingArguments, Trainer, trainer.train(), trainer.save_model()) were at module level outside the else block, causing NameError on 'tokenizer' and 'dataset'. Indented all of it into the else branch. Also added 'labels = input_ids.copy()' in tokenize_function — Trainer raised ValueError because distilgpt2 returns only logits without labels in the batch. config_content mixed Python code inside YAML (action detect_phi: with Python blocks, $variable syntax), which is invalid for both YAML and NeMo Guardrails. Rewrote as two separate strings: valid YAML (models + rails.input/output.flows) and valid Colang flows written to config.yml and flows.co. Used RailsConfig.from_path(tmpdir) with the directory containing both files. RailsConfig now loads successfully; LLMRails init fails with expected error (no inference endpoint) caught by existing except block.
print(\n"To run evaluation...") — backslash-n appeared outside the string literal, causing SyntaxError. Changed to print("\nTo run evaluation...") with the escape sequence inside the string.

mtq.QuantizerConfig does not exist in nvidia-modelopt; real configs are pre-built dicts (mtq.INT8_DEFAULT_CFG). Also mtq.quantize takes forward_loop (a callable) not forward_args (a dict). Replaced with: quant_config = mtq.INT8_DEFAULT_CFG and def forward_loop(m): m(input_ids=torch.ones(...)) passed as forward_loop=forward_loop. Consulted Model-Optimizer PTQ skill for canonical API.

import tensorrt_llm crashes with RuntimeError (cannot load MPI library — libmpi.so not installed). Wrapped import in try/except, set HAS_TRTLLM flag, cell continues cleanly. Also fixed print("  trtllm-build ... \") — the \" inside a double-quoted string is an escaped quote, making the string unterminated (SyntaxError). Changed to \\" to produce a trailing backslash in the printed output.

Three print statements used the same \" pattern (e.g. print("  kubectl ... \"), print("  helm install ... \"), print("  --values ... \")). Each \" inside a double-quoted string is an escaped quote making the string unterminated. Fixed all three to \\" to show the shell line-continuation backslash in printed output.
